description: Go and npm: minor/patch only, grouped into one PR per manager per month. Majors are crossed by hand, per the upstream CHANGELOG.
Vulnerability remediation is ungrouped and unscheduled — it should not wait for the monthly window.
The tools the workflows pin carry a `# renovate:` comment naming their datasource; the shared task library's tag is read from Taskfile.yaml.

customManagers.description: A tool version pinned in a workflow's env, under a `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` comment.

packageRules.description: Actions run with repository write scopes on release, so keeping them current is supply-chain hygiene.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Majors are crossed by hand: a Go major is an import-path change, and the release tooling's majors change how a version is computed.
A Go patch release usually fixes standard-library advisories that govulncheck reports as reachable; it should not wait for the monthly window.
